verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a self-hosting option where 'data never leaves the building' and the engine runs as a single binary on your own hardware, which lets a user fully control where data resides — but this is an all-or-nothing self-host vs. hosted-cloud choice, not a region/residency selector within the managed platform. Missing for 10: explicit hosted-cloud region selection (e.g., US/EU data center choice), documentation of data residency for the hosted product, and any independent confirmation of self-hosting residency claims.
